poly-cuban-regime-falls-in-2026.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Cuba's communist government loses power before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, set against a one-party state that has outlasted decades of US sanctions.

stocks:GS.standing: Shares of Goldman Sachs, the New York investment bank that advises on mergers, underwrites stock and bond sales and trades for clients. Its earnings rise and fall with dealmaking and market turnover.

stocks:NOK.standing: Nokia makes the radio, optical and IP networking equipment that mobile operators and data-centre builders buy, listed in Helsinki and traded in New York. Its share tracks operator capital spending and the cloud networking it has pushed into.

stocks:HSAI.standing: A Shanghai maker of lidar, the laser sensors that let cars and robots map their surroundings, listed on Nasdaq. Chinese carmakers are its main buyers, and US scrutiny of Chinese tech firms hangs over the listing.
stocks:HSAI.recent: The one piece of company news came after the slide: Hesai launched Kosmo, a lidar built for robots, on the back of 142,400 robot lidars shipped in the second quarter, up 193.4%. Nothing reported about Hesai's own business accounts for the fall in its shares.

wiki-flavio-bolsonaro.standing: The daily readership of the Wikipedia article on Flávio Bolsonaro, the Rio de Janeiro senator and eldest son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, who carries his father's movement on Brazil's right.
wiki-flavio-bolsonaro.recent: Lula overturned a first-round deficit to win the runoff by 4.4 million votes, after polls had put Bolsonaro ahead 51% to 49%. He then left Brazil through no regular border post and landed in the US, where Trump aide Simon Levy confirmed political asylum; Lula called the flight 'shameful'.

stocks:JPM.standing: The largest bank in the United States by assets, spanning Chase's consumer branches, corporate lending and one of Wall Street's biggest investment banks. Its results are read as a check on American borrowers.
stocks:JPM.recent: The CBN granted JPMorgan approval-in-principle to set up a merchant bank in Nigeria, the first licensing step for a firm that has been in Lagos since 1961. That came after the chart ends, and nothing else in the fortnight about the bank's own business explains its share price.

stocks:MS.standing: Morgan Stanley, the New York investment bank and one of Wall Street's largest wealth managers. Its profits lean on trading, dealmaking and fees on client assets, so its share tracks how busy and how high markets are.

stocks:VWAGY.standing: Volkswagen's shares, priced in dollars on the US over-the-counter market. Europe's biggest carmaker owns Audi, Porsche and Skoda, and its earnings ride on sales in China and on tariffs between Europe and the US.
stocks:VWAGY.recent: Audi, the group's premium brand, will build 200,000 cars a year in Georgia, a plant Trump claims as a tariff win at Perry. The announcement came after the latest close shown, so it does not account for the slide.

poly-will-peter-obi-win-the-2027-nigeria.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Peter Obi, the former Anambra governor who ran third in 2023, wins Nigeria's presidency in 2027. Its price is what traders will pay on an opposition upset of the ruling APC.
poly-will-peter-obi-win-the-2027-nigeria.recent: Tinubu opened his re-election campaign in Kaduna with petrol at about 1,400 naira a litre in September, the economic pain any challenger runs against, and Microsoft pledged to load Nigeria's candidate list into its AI systems. Both stories came after the days the price moved, and neither accounts for it.

poly-will-the-democrats-win-the-ohio-sen.standing: What traders on Polymarket pay for a contract that settles at 100 if a Democrat wins Ohio's 2026 US Senate race. Ohio has leaned Republican in recent statewide contests, so the seat bears on which party controls the Senate.

stocks:LLOY.L.standing: Britain's largest mortgage lender, owner of Halifax and Bank of Scotland. Almost all its lending is domestic, so its shares trade as a bet on UK interest rates, house prices and household credit.

poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Democrats win a majority in the US House of Representatives at the 2026 midterm elections. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, and House control decides whether a president's agenda can pass.
poly-will-the-democratic-party-control-t.recent: In the run-up to the midterms, charges were filed in Washington against former FBI officials over their 2023 testimony, landing 11 days before the vote. Nothing else in the fortnight's news bore on the House race, and none of it moved what traders will pay on a Democratic majority.

poly-netanyahu-out-before-2027-684-719-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Benjamin Netanyahu stops being Israel's prime minister before 2027. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with coalition crises, court cases and election timing.

poly-sudan-civil-war-ceasefire-by-decemb.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces agree a ceasefire before 2026 ends. The war, fought since April 2023, has driven the world's largest displacement crisis.

wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving prime minister. It rises with his elections, wars and trials, which have shaped Israel's politics for three decades.
wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.recent: Israel voted on 27 October and neither bloc reached 61 seats without Arab parties, after high turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel. Netanyahu ran on a doctrine making preemptive war official policy and on Trump's endorsement, against polls that put Eisenkot 8 to 10 points ahead.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-by-november-30-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI company behind the Claude models, lists its shares on a public stock exchange by 30 November 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the ceasefire between Israel and Iran is still in force on Oct 31. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it reacts to strike threats, Gulf shipping and diplomacy.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: Diplomacy filled the final fortnight. Khamenei backed Tehran's peace conditions, Saudi Arabia's defence minister met Iran's president, and Qatar tabled a seven-day plan to end the war. The strikes Washington warned Gulf states about are timed for after 3 November, beyond this contract's deadline.

stocks:AMD.standing: A Santa Clara chip designer selling x86 processors for PCs and servers and Instinct accelerators for AI data centres. Its shares price how much AI spending buyers will steer away from Nvidia.
stocks:AMD.recent: AMD was named alongside Nvidia and Broadcom as eyeing up to $5 billion of Meta's $95 billion share sale, Meta's largest ever, raised to pay for AI data centres. That came days after the share's trough, and nothing reported in the fortnight about AMD's own business accounts for the slide.

stocks:JD.standing: One of China's largest online retailers, and unlike most rivals it owns its warehouses and delivery fleet. Its Nasdaq-listed shares trade on Chinese household spending and on Beijing's stance toward platform companies.
stocks:JD.recent: JD ended deposit pre-sales for its 18th Singles' Day, so shoppers no longer pay weeks ahead to lock in a festival discount. It also said running its ad models on Huawei's Kunpeng chips cut inference latency 15%. Neither announcement explains why the shares gave ground across the fortnight.

stocks:AVGO.standing: Designs the custom AI chips and data-centre networking silicon that Google, Meta and other cloud giants build on, and owns VMware's software. Its share price is a read on how much the largest tech firms spend on AI.

poly-will-luiz-inacio-lula-da-silva-win-.standing: A Polymarket parlay that pays only if three separate things happen: Lula wins Brazil's presidency, Gadi Eisenkot becomes Israel's prime minister, and Democrats take the US Senate. If any one leg fails, it pays nothing.
poly-will-luiz-inacio-lula-da-silva-win-.recent: Polls put Eisenkot 8 to 10 points ahead of Netanyahu before Tuesday's vote. The count then left neither bloc with 61 seats without the Arab parties, and both blocs treat an Arab partner as taboo, so Eisenkot's route to the premiership runs through them or a sixth election. Nothing here bears on the Lula or Senate legs.

wiki-pakistan.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on Pakistan, the nuclear-armed South Asian state of more than 240 million people. It shows when world events send people looking for the country's basics.
wiki-pakistan.recent: A school roof collapse in Peshawar killed at least 20 children in mid-October, and Islamabad ordered school inspections. Since then a Rs114-a-litre petrol levy has drawn a Jamaat-i-Islami threat to march on Islamabad, police have crushed Khyber protests, and army chief Asim Munir has shuttled to Tehran amid the US peace deal deadlock.

stocks:HSBA.L.standing: One of the world's largest banks, headquartered in London but earning most of its profit in Asia, chiefly Hong Kong. Its earnings follow interest rates, and its shares trade on its position between China and the West.
stocks:HSBA.L.recent: The slide came before HSBC reported its July-September results, a pretax profit of $9.6 billion, so those figures do not explain it. Nothing else reported about the bank in this period accounts for the fall.

poly-will-david-lisnard-win-the-2027-fre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if David Lisnard, the centre-right mayor of Cannes, wins France's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

stocks:HAPV3.SA.standing: One of Brazil's largest private health-plan operators, running its own hospitals and clinics, and listed on the B3 in São Paulo. Its margins move with medical-cost inflation and with the rules the regulator ANS sets for health plans.
stocks:HAPV3.SA.recent: The only report on Hapvida's own business here appeared after the fall and does not explain it: an Agência Pública investigation found that STF justice André Mendonça ruled twice in the company's favour weeks after meeting one of its executives at a seminar in Frankfurt.

stocks:VOW3.DE.standing: Europe's largest carmaker by sales, owner of Audi, Porsche, Škoda and SEAT, listed in Frankfurt. The Porsche and Piëch families control it and Lower Saxony holds a fifth of its votes, so politics shapes its pay and plants.
stocks:VOW3.DE.recent: Volkswagen plans a pay freeze for 660,000 workers until 2030. Its Audi unit committed $4 billion to a Georgia plant building 200,000 cars a year, announced on Trump's stage under tariff pressure. Audi is also in talks for Huawei to develop its next A8. All of it came after the share's low, and none of it accounts for the price.

stocks:002230.SZ.standing: A Hefei-based maker of speech-recognition and AI software, listed in Shenzhen, whose Spark models sell into Chinese schools and government. On the US entity list since 2019, it is a test of building AI without American chips.
stocks:002230.SZ.recent: iFlytek said it trained its Spark X2.6 model on domestic chips, without Nvidia, and that one training run fell from 4.5 months to 1.2. For a company shut out of American hardware by export controls, that bears directly on its business: it can keep building models on chips it is allowed to buy.

stocks:005930.KS.standing: South Korea's largest company and one of the world's biggest makers of memory chips, smartphones and displays. It carries so much weight in Seoul's stock market that its share price moves the national index with it.
stocks:005930.KS.recent: The company was reportedly ending home appliance sales in Hong Kong and launched a $229 cuff-shaped Galaxy Buds model; neither accounts for the share price.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire by the end of November 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with each round of talks and each wave of strikes.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.recent: Talks are moving but not toward a truce: Witkoff met Putin and the Kremlin confirmed Abu Dhabi talks for November, yet Putin wants a final settlement, not a "short" truce, and Lavrov says the war will continue and likely escalate. The Oleshky ceasefire Melania Trump announced covers up to 2,000 people, not the front.

stocks:SHEL.standing: Shell is a London-based oil and gas major and one of the world's largest traders of liquefied natural gas. Its shares rise and fall with crude and gas prices, and with how much cash it returns to shareholders.
stocks:SHEL.recent: The only news about Shell in the fortnight came from Nigeria, where its unit and Chevron's reported identical methane emissions for 2022. Nothing in it explains the share price.

wiki-vladimir-putin.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on Vladimir Putin, who has run Russia as president or prime minister since 2000. It jumps when the Kremlin makes a war decision or he sits down with a Western leader.
wiki-vladimir-putin.recent: Putin freed Stephen Hubbard during Steve Witkoff's visit to St Petersburg, proposed a summit with Trump and Xi that would seat no Ukrainian, and said Russia was ready to resume Ukraine talks by mid-November. All of it came after the earlier spike, which nothing here explains.

stocks:BAC.standing: The second-largest US bank by assets, holding deposits for tens of millions of American households. Much of that money sits in bonds, so its earnings and share price move with interest rates.
stocks:BAC.recent: Bank of America's unrealized losses on the bonds it holds rose to $109 billion. Those are paper losses on securities bought when yields were lower. They do not hit earnings unless the bank sells, but they tie up capital it could otherwise lend or return to shareholders.

stocks:FITB.standing: A Cincinnati-based regional bank lending to households and companies across the US Midwest and Southeast. Its share price turns on the gap between what it pays depositors and what it earns on loans, so it answers to Fed rate moves.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on talks, envoys and sanctions decisions.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.recent: Money moved toward a truce when the Kremlin confirmed talks in Abu Dhabi and Melania Trump announced a local ceasefire for Oleshky, though Putin said he wanted a final settlement, not a short truce. Since then Lavrov has said the war will continue and likely escalate, and a Putin aide said Washington cannot force Kyiv to comply.

poly-predictfun-fdv-above-1b-one-day-aft.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Predict.fun's token, once it launches, has a fully diluted valuation above $1 billion on its first full day. That is the price of every token that will ever exist, not only those already trading.
poly-predictfun-fdv-above-1b-one-day-aft.recent: The fortnight's prediction-market news was about regulation. The CFTC sued 10 states, Utah among them, to shield platforms such as Kalshi from gambling bans, and a Pentagon memo warned that insider bets put troops' lives at risk. None of it concerns Predict.fun's token or its launch.

wiki-luiz-inacio-lula-da-silva.standing: How many people read the Wikipedia article on Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva each day. He is a former metalworker and union leader who founded Brazil's Workers' Party and has been elected the country's president more than once.
wiki-luiz-inacio-lula-da-silva.recent: Lula overturned a first-round deficit to beat Flávio Bolsonaro by 4.4 million votes, after polls had put his rival narrowly ahead. Real futures fell 10% on the result. Bolsonaro then left Brazil through no regular border post and landed in the US, where a Trump aide confirmed political asylum.

stocks:CVX.standing: The second-largest American oil major, pumping crude and gas from the Permian Basin to Kazakhstan and Australia and refining it into fuel. Its shares follow the oil price, and its dividend draws income investors.
stocks:CVX.recent: The one story about its own business was a disclosure question: its Nigerian unit and Shell's reported identical methane emissions for 2022. Nothing in that accounts for the share's rise.

stocks:AAPL.standing: Shares of the Cupertino maker of the iPhone, Mac and iPad, one of the world's most valuable listed companies. The iPhone earns most of its revenue, and its products are assembled largely in China on chips made in Taiwan.
stocks:AAPL.recent: iPhone Duo pre-orders were backordered until 2027 on the day they opened. The same week, Apple Intelligence went live in China on Alibaba's Qwen models, the approval Apple needed to sell its AI features there. The M6 chip then arrived in a touchscreen MacBook Pro and the iMac.

stocks:ISP.MI.standing: Italy's largest bank by assets, listed in Milan, with a dominant share of the country's retail deposits and a big book of Italian government bonds, so its shares move with Italian sovereign risk.
stocks:ISP.MI.recent: The ECB gave Intesa Sanpaolo authorisation to take over Monte dei Paschi, clearing the way for a €32 billion bid. That approval came only this week, after the shares had already slid, and nothing else in the input explains the earlier fall.

stocks:002415.SZ.standing: The world's largest maker of video-surveillance cameras, listed in Shenzhen and controlled by state-owned CETC. US sanctions and Western bans on its gear in government sites limit what it can sell abroad.

stocks:BMPS.MI.standing: The Siena lender founded in 1472, the oldest bank still operating. The Italian state rescued it in 2017, and its fate has since been a test of how far Italy's banks will consolidate.
stocks:BMPS.MI.recent: The ECB authorised Intesa Sanpaolo to take over Monte dei Paschi, which clears Italy's largest bank to bid €32 billion for the Siena lender. The approval came at the end of the period, and nothing reported before it accounts for the share's earlier fall.

stocks:002236.SZ.standing: One of China's two largest makers of surveillance cameras and video systems, based in Hangzhou. US export blacklisting and an FCC equipment ban shut it out of American markets, so its sales lean on China and emerging markets.

stocks:000063.SZ.standing: China's second-largest telecom equipment maker after Huawei, based in Shenzhen and listed there and in Hong Kong. A 2018 US export ban nearly shut it down, so its shares move on Washington's rules on chips.

poly-flavio-bolsonaro-charged-or-arreste.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Flávio Bolsonaro, Brazilian senator and eldest son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, is charged or arrested before its deadline. It tracks how far Brazil's courts reach into the family.

poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the Federal Reserve raises its benchmark rate by a quarter point after its December 2026 meeting. That rate sets US borrowing costs and moves the dollar and Treasury yields.
poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.recent: The Fed held at 3.75-4% on Wednesday, a month after its first hike in three years, and Kevin Warsh said more data would guide the next move. With markets fully pricing a December hike, this contract bets on a rise beyond it, fed by oil-driven inflation from the Iran war; in Bangkok, Warsh had called AI a shock to the economy.

stocks:COIN.standing: The largest US cryptocurrency exchange, listed on Nasdaq. Most of its revenue comes from trading fees and custody, so its shares move with crypto prices and how much people trade.

stocks:AMPL.standing: Amplitude sells product-analytics software that records how people use apps and websites, so companies can see which features keep customers. Its subscription revenue rises and falls with corporate software budgets.

stocks:RELIANCE.NS.standing: India's most valuable company, controlled by Mukesh Ambani: the world's largest refining complex at Jamnagar, the Jio telecom network and a vast retail chain. Its shares move with refining margins and Indian consumer demand.
stocks:RELIANCE.NS.recent: Reliance took Jio Platforms public in India's largest offering, which filled in 100 minutes and drew sovereign funds. Jio listed 25% above issue at $137.1 billion, second only to its parent. Rubio meanwhile pressed India's refiners to take more Venezuelan crude, tying its Russian oil waiver to a trade deal.

poly-will-the-republicans-win-the-south-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if a Republican wins South Carolina's 2026 US Senate race. The state last sent a Democrat to the Senate in 1998, so the price is a bet on how safe that hold is.

stocks:3988.HK.standing: One of China's four large state-owned commercial banks, and the most international of them: it clears offshore yuan in Hong Kong and other centres, so its shares carry both Beijing's credit policy and the yuan's spread abroad.
stocks:3988.HK.recent: The one piece of news about the bank's own business was a 2 billion yuan bond it sold in Dubai, which drew 5 times demand as Beijing pushed yuan-denominated assets abroad. It came on the last day shown and accounts for none of the share's earlier swings.

stocks:ADANIENT.NS.standing: The flagship listed company of India's Adani Group, which starts new businesses such as airports, mining, roads and copper before spinning them off. Its share price is the market's read on the whole conglomerate's debt and governance.
stocks:ADANIENT.NS.recent: Adani Enterprises returned to profit in its latest quarter on its copper, renewables and airports units, and copper now supplies nearly 40% of its revenue. The results arrived after the share's slide, and nothing reported about the company this month accounts for the fall.

poly-will-raam-win-exactly-7-seats-in-th.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays if Ra'am, the Islamist party of Israel's Arab citizens, wins exactly 7 of the Knesset's 120 seats. In 2021 it became the first Arab party to join an Israeli governing coalition.
poly-will-raam-win-exactly-7-seats-in-th.recent: Israel voted on Tuesday. With 85.6% counted, Netanyahu's bloc held about 53 seats, and Eisenkot's opposition also fell short of a Knesset majority without the parties of Israel's Palestinian citizens, whose turnout was historic. Any government that excludes Netanyahu now depends on parties like Ra'am.

stocks:TTE.standing: France's largest oil and gas company, with production across Africa, the Middle East and the North Sea and one of the world's biggest LNG portfolios. Its share moves with crude and gas prices and refining margins.

stocks:DKNG.standing: A Boston-based online sportsbook and daily fantasy sports operator, one of the two largest in the US. Its revenue rests on which states legalise betting, how they tax it, and how much bettors lose each weekend.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-us-pr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the former Florida senator who became Donald Trump's secretary of state, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders pay per dollar for that outcome.
poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-us-pr.recent: The fortnight's US political news was the charging of ex-FBI officials over 2023 testimony days before the midterms, and none of it concerns Rubio or accounts for the contract's price.

poly-will-dan-sullivan-win-the-alaska-se.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Dan Sullivan, Alaska's Republican senator since 2015, wins the state's 2026 Senate race. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, in cents on the dollar.

poly-xi-jinping-out-before-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Xi Jinping leaves power before 2027. It is what bettors will pay on a leadership change in China, where succession has no public timetable and Xi has named no heir.

wiki-turkey.standing: Daily reads of Wikipedia's article on Turkey, the NATO member spanning Europe and Asia whose Bosporus strait is the Black Sea's only route to open water.
wiki-turkey.recent: Turkey launched the Osman Gazi, its first floating gas platform, set to double output from the Sakarya field. Days later Ankara sent parliament a 16-article Makkah pact that would bind it to defend Riyadh, Libya's eastern parliament ratified Turkey's 2019 maritime deal, and Canada, which once embargoed Turkey, signed a defence partnership.

poly-will-the-republicans-win-the-michig.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if a Republican wins Michigan's US Senate seat in November 2026, an open seat in a swing state. It is one of a handful of races that decide which party controls the Senate.

poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the United States invades Iran before the end of 2026. An invasion is a far larger step than air strikes, so the price is a bet on a ground war, not on more bombing.
poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.recent: Washington has warned the Gulf states that host its bases of a 'short, intense' war on Iran after the 3 November midterms, while Qatar's seven-day plan to end the war sits with mediators. Israel's army chief reportedly warned Washington off striking Iran, and Khamenei backed Tehran's war conditions. Every threat on the table is of strikes, not an invasion.

poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States lifts its naval blockade of Iran before the end of November 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with talks, strikes and Hormuz shipping.
poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.recent: Mid-October brought talk of the US using the 'Mother of All Bombs' on Iran and a secret Netanyahu-Hegseth meeting at a south Israel airbase. Qatar has since tabled a seven-day plan to end the war, but Khamenei backed Tehran's war conditions and US officials warned Gulf states of strikes after 3 November.

poly-over-20m-committed-to-the-1w-public.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if commitments to 1W's public sale exceed $20 million. Its price is what traders will pay for a yes, and it settles on the sale's reported total.

stocks:JBLU.standing: The share price of JetBlue Airways, a New York-based US airline built around JFK and Boston, flying domestic, Caribbean and transatlantic routes. Fuel costs and its own debt load weigh on it more than on larger rivals.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the truce between Israel and Iran is still in force at the end of the year. Its price is what traders will stake on the ceasefire surviving, set by money rather than by any forecaster.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: Washington has warned Gulf states of a 'short, intense' war on Iran after the 3 November midterms, and the IRGC says three tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz on a route Tehran had not authorised. Qatar's seven-day plan to end the war is with mediators, but an Iranian official called its ideas 'unacceptable'.

poly-us-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-throu.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the ceasefire between the United States and Iran survives to 8 November. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, and it reacts to Gulf strikes and to talks through mediators.
poly-us-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-throu.recent: Saudi Arabia's defence minister met Iran's president in Tehran, Khamenei backed Tehran's peace conditions, Qatar tabled a seven-day plan to end the war, and Vance wrote to Iran's security chief Rezaei. Against that, US officials warned Gulf states of strikes after 3 November, inside this contract's window.

stocks:TGT.standing: Shares of Target, the Minneapolis-based discount retailer with nearly 2,000 US stores selling groceries, clothing and household goods. Its sales read directly on how much middle-income American households will spend.

stocks:WMT.standing: The world's largest retailer by revenue, running supermarkets and warehouse clubs across the US and abroad. Its sales show what American households at every income level are spending on groceries and essentials.
stocks:WMT.recent: The one story about Walmart's own affairs landed after the latest close: it joined Eli Lilly and 36 others in objecting to OKX and ICE trading tokenized versions of their shares. That is a fight over who controls the stock's record, and nothing in it accounts for the price.

stocks:WDS.standing: The Australian oil and gas producer behind the North West Shelf and Pluto LNG plants in Western Australia, shown here by its New York listing. Its earnings ride on Asian LNG contracts, most of them priced off oil.
stocks:WDS.recent: The one deal in the news landed after this chart ends: QatarEnergy agreed to buy up to 3 million tonnes a year of US liquefied natural gas through Woodside. Qatar is turning to American supply because the Hormuz force majeure is holding up its own exports. Nothing reported before that accounts for the price.

stocks:LLY.standing: The Indianapolis drugmaker behind the diabetes and obesity drugs Mounjaro and Zepbound. Their sales have made it the world's most valuable pharmaceutical company, so its share price is a running bet on the weight-loss market.
stocks:LLY.recent: Eli Lilly joined Walmart and 36 other companies in objecting to OKX and ICE's plan to trade tokenized versions of their shares. That leaves most of the issuers asked opting out, but nothing in the news accounts for the rise in Lilly's own stock.

stocks:ICE.standing: The company that owns the New York Stock Exchange, the futures market where Brent crude trades, and the clearing houses behind both. Much of its income comes from trading volume, so volatility tends to reach its share.
stocks:ICE.recent: Walmart and Eli Lilly joined 36 others objecting to OKX and ICE's plan to trade tokenized versions of their shares, and most of the companies asked have now opted out. That is a setback for the venture, and it does not account for the share's rise.

poly-will-no-qualifying-diplomatic-us-ir.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if no senior American and Iranian officials meet before 2026 ends. The two governments have met at that level only rarely since 1979, so a meeting would break a long pattern.
poly-will-no-qualifying-diplomatic-us-ir.recent: Khamenei, unseen since March, backed Tehran's war conditions, and Washington warned Gulf states of strikes after the 3 November midterms. Since then Vance has written to Iran's security chief Rezaei, Qatar has put a seven-day plan to end the war on the table, and Araghchi says Tehran is in contact with mediators.

poly-will-christine-lagarde-win-the-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Christine Lagarde, the European Central Bank president and former French finance minister, wins France's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders will stake on her entering and winning the race.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if JD Vance, Donald Trump's vice president, wins the November 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with the Republican succession.

poly-will-the-iranian-regime-fall-by-the.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Iran's Islamic Republic loses power before 1 January 2027. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on war, unrest and the hold of the leadership in Tehran.
poly-will-the-iranian-regime-fall-by-the.recent: Khamenei, unseen since March, publicly backed Tehran's conditions for ending the war, and Saudi Arabia's defence minister met Iran's president as Qatar tabled a seven-day plan. Against that, strikes cut Iran's gas capacity by a fifth and forced rationing, and US officials warned Gulf states of strikes after 3 November.

stocks:CG.standing: One of the world's largest private-equity firms, based in Washington, running buyout, credit and infrastructure funds for pensions and endowments. Its earnings swing on the profits it books when it sells what it owns.
stocks:CG.recent: The only news here about Carlyle's own business came on 2026-10-29, after the last close shown: with the EBRD, it is selling Black Sea Oil & Gas, Romania's offshore gas producer, to Mazarine Energy as EU gas tops €100. That sale does not account for the earlier moves in the share.

stocks:SNP.RO.standing: Romania's largest oil and gas producer, listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange and controlled by Austria's OMV, with the Romanian state as a minority holder. It develops the Black Sea's Neptun Deep gas field with Romgaz.

stocks:SNG.RO.standing: Romania's largest natural gas producer, majority-owned by the state and listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange. It owns half of Neptun Deep, the deep-water Black Sea gas project it is developing with OMV Petrom.

stocks:CART.standing: Maplebear is the company behind Instacart, the North American app that sends gig shoppers to pick and deliver groceries from supermarket shelves. It earns from delivery fees and from ads that brands buy inside the app.
stocks:CART.recent: DoorDash agreed to buy Instacart, which would fold the two largest delivery apps into one company and put the gig workers on both under a single employer. A takeover sets a price the buyer will pay for every share, and the stock moves toward it.

stocks:DASH.standing: DoorDash runs the largest food-delivery app in the United States and owns Wolt in Europe. Its share price follows order volume and the rules governing how it pays and dispatches its gig couriers.
stocks:DASH.recent: DoorDash agreed to buy Instacart for $17 billion, joining the two largest US app-delivery platforms across restaurants and groceries under one set of courier pay and dispatch rules. The deal came after the last close shown, so it does not explain the fall. It faces antitrust review by the FTC, which began probing pay algorithms this week.
